beats.label: S1 · Through the stones
beats.text: In 1945, WWII nurse Claire touches a stone at Craigh na Dun and wakes in 1743, rescued from Frank's brutal ancestor Black Jack Randall by Highlander Jamie Fraser.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the whole premise: two timelines, two men, and the enemy who will drive the season.

beats.label: S1 · Guest at Castle Leoch
beats.text: At Castle Leoch she is suspected as a spy but earns her place as healer under laird Colum MacKenzie, and hears a folk tale that the stones can send her home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes her captivity, her cover, and the first hope that time travel is real and reversible.

beats.label: S1 · On the road with Dougal
beats.text: Riding with Colum's brother Dougal she learns he is raising funds for the doomed Jacobite rising, and Black Jack Randall recaptures her at Fort William.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the political stakes and puts her back in Randall's hands, forcing the marriage.

beats.label: S1 · The wedding
beats.text: To keep Claire out of English hands, Dougal makes her marry Jamie so she becomes Scottish by law; despite loving Frank, she falls for Jamie for real.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's central love story is built here — everything else in the series flows from this bond.

beats.label: S1 · Witch trial
beats.text: Convicted of witchcraft with secret time-traveller Geillis Duncan, Claire is saved when Geillis takes the blame; at the stones she chooses Jamie over 1945.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms Claire's active choice to stay in the past, and plants Geillis as a 1968 traveller.

beats.label: S1 · Wentworth
beats.text: Jamie is captured at Wentworth Prison and broken by Black Jack Randall through rape and torture; Murtagh rescues him but his mind is shattered.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The trauma that defines Jamie's psychology going into S2 and haunts him for seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Sailing for France
beats.text: They flee for France so Claire can try to prevent the coming Battle of Culloden — and she tells a broken Jamie she is carrying his child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the entire S2 mission (stop Culloden) and the pregnancy that drives it.

cliffhanger.text: A shattered Jamie and a pregnant Claire sail for France, hoping to derail Prince Charles Stuart's rebellion before it can lead to Culloden.
questions: Can Jamie recover from what Randall did to him?
Can two people really change the course of history?
What happens to the child Claire is carrying?

characters.name: Claire Randall Fraser
characters.line: 1945 combat nurse thrown to 1743; now Jamie's wife, pregnant, bound for France to try to stop Culloden.

characters.name: Jamie Fraser
characters.line: Young Highland warrior with a price on his head; Claire's second husband, traumatised after Wentworth.

characters.name: Frank Randall
characters.line: Claire's 20th-century husband, still searching for her at the stones in 1946.

characters.name: Captain Jonathan "Black Jack" Randall
characters.line: Sadistic English dragoon and Frank's ancestor, left for dead by Murtagh at Wentworth.

characters.name: Dougal MacKenzie
characters.line: Clan MacKenzie war chief, secretly raising funds for the Jacobite cause.

characters.name: Colum MacKenzie
characters.line: Ailing laird of Castle Leoch, trying to keep his clan out of the coming rebellion.

characters.name: Murtagh Fitzgibbons Fraser
characters.line: Jamie's grim godfather; engineered the Wentworth rescue and sails to France with them.

characters.name: Geillis Duncan
characters.line: Fellow time-traveller from 1968; burned as a witch, pregnant with Dougal's child.

beats.label: S2 · Return to 1948
beats.text: Framed around 1948: Claire has come back through the stones to Frank, pregnant with Jamie's child, and vows a new life raising the baby as their own.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The whole season is a flashback bracketed by this return; establishes she does make it home.

beats.label: S2 · Paris plot
beats.text: Back in 1744 Paris, Claire and Jamie court Prince Charles Stuart, Versailles and the Duke of Sandringham, trying to sabotage the Jacobite rebellion from within.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season's central mission and the political world they must manipulate.

beats.label: S2 · Randall lives
beats.text: Claire discovers Black Jack Randall is alive and hides it from Jamie; Jamie takes in a Parisian pickpocket boy named Fergus and adopts him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reactivates the Randall wound and introduces Fergus, who becomes family from here on.

beats.label: S2 · The dinner party
beats.text: A dinner staged to discredit Charles collapses in scandal; en route Mary Hawkins is raped, and Jamie later duels Randall despite his promise to Claire.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pivot that costs them everything in Paris and puts Jamie in the Bastille.

beats.label: S2 · Faith
beats.text: A pregnant Claire collapses at the duel; their daughter Faith is stillborn, and Claire sleeps with Louis XV to buy Jamie's freedom before they leave Paris.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's emotional low point; Faith's name and fate matter far later.

beats.label: S2 · Prestonpans and Dougal
beats.text: Back in Scotland Jamie is dragged into the doomed rising, wins Prestonpans, and finally kills Dougal to keep secret a last plot to stop Prince Charles.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Scottish uprising arc and removes Dougal for good; the Prince has slipped their grip.

beats.label: S2 · Eve of Culloden
beats.text: On the eve of Culloden Jamie sends a pregnant Claire back through the stones; in 1968 she learns from Roger that Jamie survived the battle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits the timelines for the next season and gives Claire (and the audience) a reason to go back.

cliffhanger.text: Twenty years on, Claire knows Jamie lived through Culloden but not where or when to find him now; Brianna has just learned Frank is not her father, and Geillis Duncan has already vanished into the stones ahead of them.
questions: Where in history has Jamie ended up?
Will Brianna help her mother find him?
What did Geillis go back to do?

characters.name: Claire Fraser
characters.line: In 1968 Inverness, twenty years widowed from Frank, chasing a trail that says Jamie survived Culloden.

characters.name: Jamie Fraser
characters.line: Sent Claire home before Culloden; survived the battle, whereabouts unknown from 1746 onward.

characters.name: Brianna Randall
characters.line: Twenty-year-old daughter of Claire and Jamie; only now learning her real father is a Highlander from the 1700s.

characters.name: Roger Wakefield
characters.line: Reverend Wakefield's grown ward, the historian who tracked Jamie's survival and shows Claire the proof.

characters.name: Frank Randall
characters.line: Raised Brianna as his own daughter; now dead.

characters.name: Fergus
characters.line: French orphan Jamie adopted in Paris; the closest thing Jamie has to a son during Culloden.

characters.name: Faith Fraser
characters.line: Claire and Jamie's daughter, stillborn in Paris and buried there.

characters.name: Geillis Duncan / Gillian Edgars
characters.line: 1968 activist revealed as the same time-traveller from S1; already stepped back through the stones.

beats.label: S3 · Boston without Jamie
beats.text: In 1948 Boston, Claire raises Jamie's daughter Brianna with Frank; their marriage strains under Jamie's ghost until Frank dies in a car crash years later.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes out the 20th-century marriage and frees Claire to eventually return.

beats.label: S3 · Twenty years on the run
beats.text: Jamie survives Culloden after killing Randall, spared by Lord Melton; he lives as a Lallybroch outlaw for years, then surrenders so his family can claim the reward.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains the gap and how Jamie enters English custody, which sets up Ardsmuir.

beats.label: S3 · Ardsmuir and Helwater
beats.text: At Ardsmuir Jamie befriends the young English governor Lord John Grey; paroled to Helwater, he fathers a secret son William with the doomed Geneva Dunsany.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Lord John and William, who become permanent fixtures.

beats.label: S3 · Back through the stones
beats.text: In 1968, Brianna, Roger and Claire find Jamie's trail in an Edinburgh print shop; Claire steps back through the stones for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reunion the season has been building to and Claire's final one-way trip.

beats.label: S3 · Reunion and Laoghaire
beats.text: Reunited with Jamie, Claire meets grown Fergus and nephew Young Ian, then discovers at Lallybroch that Jamie has taken Laoghaire as a second wife.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Young Ian and reactivates Laoghaire, both of whom drive later plots.

beats.label: S3 · Chase to Jamaica
beats.text: Young Ian is kidnapped from Silky Isle to Jamaica; Jamie and Claire pursue on the Artemis and reach Kingston, where Governor Lord John hosts them at a ball.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts everyone on the boat that will wreck them onto a new continent.

beats.label: S3 · Shipwrecked in Georgia
beats.text: They rescue Ian from Geillis Duncan, who dies at Claire's hand; escaping by sea they are shipwrecked and wash up on the shore of colonial Georgia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off Geillis and relocates the entire show to the American colonies.

cliffhanger.text: Claire and Jamie are alive but stranded on a beach in British America, with no ship, no plan, and enemies both English and colonial still hunting Jamie.
questions: How do they build a life here?
Who else in the Colonies knows Jamie is a wanted man?
What becomes of Young Ian after everything he has just seen?

characters.name: Claire Fraser
characters.line: Reunited with Jamie for good, now washed up in the American colonies after fleeing Jamaica.

characters.name: Jamie Fraser
characters.line: Former Edinburgh printer and smuggler; wanted for treason and murder in the British Empire.

characters.name: Brianna Randall Fraser
characters.line: Their daughter, left behind in 1968 knowing her true father.

characters.name: Roger Wakefield MacKenzie
characters.line: Historian in 1968; in love with Brianna and the only other person who knows Claire is gone.

characters.name: Lord John Grey
characters.line: Former Ardsmuir governor, now Governor of Jamaica; Jamie's closest friend and William's guardian.

characters.name: William Ransom
characters.line: Jamie's secret son by Geneva Dunsany, being raised as an English earl by Lord John and Isobel.

characters.name: Young Ian Murray
characters.line: Jenny's teenage son, rescued from Geillis in Jamaica; now in the Colonies with Jamie and Claire.

characters.name: Fergus Fraser
characters.line: Grown adopted son of Jamie, married to Laoghaire's daughter Marsali.

characters.name: Laoghaire MacKenzie
characters.line: Jamie's second wife by law; still living, still owed alimony.

beats.label: S4 · Meeting Stephen Bonnet
beats.text: Stranded in North Carolina, Jamie and Claire help escaped pirate Stephen Bonnet flee the noose — who then robs them of Geillis's gemstones and Claire's wedding ring.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Bonnet, the season's antagonist, and plants the ring that later exposes him.

beats.label: S4 · Fraser's Ridge
beats.text: At his aunt Jocasta's plantation River Run, Jamie refuses to inherit her slaves; they settle Fraser's Ridge in Cherokee country on land granted by Governor Tryon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Ridge as the new home base and Jamie's debt to Tryon.

beats.label: S4 · Murtagh reappears
beats.text: Jamie is reunited with Murtagh, now a blacksmith and secret leader of the Regulator movement against Tryon's colonial government.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the collision course between Jamie's oath to Tryon and his loyalty to Murtagh.

beats.label: S4 · Brianna comes back
beats.text: In 1970 Brianna discovers her parents will die in a fire and travels back through the stones without telling Roger; he follows on Bonnet's ship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Brings the 20th-century family into the 18th century for good, and puts Roger under Bonnet's control.

beats.label: S4 · Wilmington
beats.text: In Wilmington Stephen Bonnet brutally rapes Brianna; Roger arrives but is misidentified as the attacker, beaten senseless by Jamie, and sold to the Mohawk.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The wound at the centre of the rest of the season and Brianna's pregnancy.

beats.label: S4 · Rescue from the Mohawk
beats.text: Jamie, Claire and Young Ian track Roger to the Mohawk; Ian offers himself in Roger's place so Roger can return to a pregnant Brianna.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Trades one family member for another and leaves Young Ian with the Mohawk going into S5.

beats.label: S4 · Tryon's letter
beats.text: Roger accepts Brianna's child as his own; then Governor Tryon orders Jamie to hunt down and kill the Regulator leader — his own godfather Murtagh.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The impossible order that opens the next season.

cliffhanger.text: Jamie has been ordered by the man who granted him his land to hunt down and kill his own godfather, while Young Ian remains a captive of the Mohawk.
questions: Can Jamie refuse Tryon without losing Fraser's Ridge?
Whose child is Brianna carrying — Roger's or Bonnet's?
Will Young Ian ever come home?

characters.name: Jamie Fraser
characters.line: Laird of Fraser's Ridge in North Carolina, sworn to Tryon under threat and now ordered against Murtagh.

characters.name: Claire Fraser
characters.line: Rebuilding as healer on the frontier, reunited with the daughter she had not seen for twenty years.

characters.name: Brianna Fraser MacKenzie
characters.line: New mother of a son of uncertain paternity after Bonnet's assault.

characters.name: Roger MacKenzie
characters.line: Returned from the Mohawk to a pregnant Brianna; has accepted the child as his own.

characters.name: Young Ian Murray
characters.line: Given to the Mohawk in Roger's place; being adopted into the tribe.

characters.name: Lord John Grey
characters.line: Visited the Ridge with young William; Jamie's oldest friend and William's guardian.

characters.name: William Ransom
characters.line: A young English heir growing into himself, still unaware Jamie is his father.

characters.name: Murtagh Fitzgibbons
characters.line: Jamie's godfather and Regulator leader; the man Tryon has just ordered Jamie to kill.

characters.name: Stephen Bonnet
characters.line: Escaped pirate, thief, and Brianna's rapist; still at large with Claire's wedding ring.

characters.name: Jocasta Cameron
characters.line: Jamie's blind aunt at River Run, matriarch of the plantation and sponsor to Brianna.

beats.label: S5 · Cunningham and the book
beats.text: On Fraser's Ridge, ex-Tory Captain Cunningham arrives with trader Hiram Crombie; Jamie reads Frank Randall's book warning of his own death at the Battle of Kings Mountain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's antagonist and its fixed-date threat to Jamie's life.

beats.label: S5 · Fergus's parentage
beats.text: Percival Beauchamp arrives to reveal Fergus's true parentage — son of the Comte St Germain — and offers to hand him the Comte's Paris estate.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Fergus's later inheritance and Marsali's post-Fergus survival.

beats.label: S5 · Cunningham exposed
beats.text: Cunningham is unmasked as a British spy recruiting loyalists on Jamie's land; when he attacks Jamie, Buck MacKenzie shoots him and leaves him paralysed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Breaks Cunningham's plot but binds Jamie to the militia leader Cleveland who came to help.

beats.label: S5 · Fire and Faith
beats.text: Fergus dies in a print-shop fire; a lace square and an old song tie the orphan Fanny to Claire's daughter Faith, hinting Faith did not die in Paris.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off Fergus and cracks open the season's biggest mystery about Claire's stillborn child.

beats.label: S5 · William reconciles
beats.text: William and Jamie reconcile in the forest; William confronts Amaranthus over her role in faking his cousin Ben's death, and finds Ben alive as a Continental turncoat.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Repairs the father-son wound and opens the Ben Grey / Amaranthus triangle for later.

beats.label: S5 · Rescuing Lord John
beats.text: Captain Richardson kidnaps Lord John; the family free him and Richardson is revealed as a fellow time-traveller trying to keep the Colonies British — John kills him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms other travellers with agendas exist, and puts Jamie and John back on the same side.

beats.label: S5 · Marriage of convenience
beats.text: Jamie is reported drowned at sea and Lord John marries Claire to save her from the gallows — then Jamie returns alive, and William stumbles onto the truth of his birth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Triangulates Jamie, Claire and John, and finally puts William's real parentage in the open.

cliffhanger.text: Jamie is now a Continental Brigadier General under Washington and has escaped British arrest by taking Lord John hostage; William knows the truth of his birth and is furious; Kings Mountain is still coming.
questions: Can Jamie survive the battle Frank's book says will kill him?
Will William ever forgive Jamie and Claire?
What becomes of Lord John, now a Continental prisoner condemned for the Paoli Massacre?

characters.name: Jamie Fraser
characters.line: Laird of Fraser's Ridge and new Continental Brigadier General, warned by Frank's book of his death at Kings Mountain.

characters.name: Claire Fraser
characters.line: Healer on the Ridge; briefly Lady John Grey while Jamie was presumed lost at sea.

characters.name: William Ransom
characters.line: British officer and Jamie's illegitimate son, now aware of his true parentage and estranged.

characters.name: Lord John Grey
characters.line: Jamie's oldest friend and William's stepfather; married Claire to save her, now a Continental prisoner condemned to hang.

characters.name: Amaranthus Cowden Grey
characters.line: William's cousin-in-law; secretly orchestrated Ben's faked death, now entangled with William.

characters.name: Ben Grey
characters.line: John's nephew, faked his own death and turned coat to the Continental Army.

characters.name: Fanny Pocock
characters.line: Young girl the Frasers took in; her keepsake and song hint she may be Claire's granddaughter through the surviving Faith.

characters.name: Buck MacKenzie
characters.line: Roger's 18th-century ancestor; shot Cunningham to save Jamie's life.

characters.name: Brianna & Roger MacKenzie
characters.line: Roger fights with Marion's Patriots; Brianna forges a Hall rifle for the coming battle and is again pregnant.

beats.label: S6 · Cunningham comes to the Ridge
beats.text: Ex-Tory Captain Cunningham arrives on Fraser's Ridge with trader Hiram Crombie; Jamie reads Frank Randall's book warning of his own death at Kings Mountain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's antagonist and Jamie's fixed-date fate.

beats.label: S6 · Cunningham's prophecy
beats.text: Cunningham prophecies at Lodge that he has seven years from Saratoga to live; William hunts down what really happened to his cousin Ben in Continental custody.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Cunningham's zealotry in motion and opens the Ben Grey mystery.

beats.label: S6 · Spy unmasked, Fergus's father named
beats.text: Jamie unmasks Cunningham as a British spy sent by Cornwallis; Percival Beauchamp reveals Fergus is the Comte St Germain's son with a Paris estate waiting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names both antagonists' plans and Fergus's hidden inheritance.

beats.label: S6 · Buck saves Jamie
beats.text: Cunningham attacks Jamie on the Ridge; Buck MacKenzie shoots Cunningham and leaves him paralysed, and Ben Grey is discovered alive as a Continental turncoat.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Breaks Cunningham's rebellion and opens the Ben / Amaranthus / William triangle.

beats.label: S6 · Mercy on the Ridge
beats.text: Rather than kill his betrayers, Jamie evicts them and later grants their wives new tenancy contracts; Ian is granted his son by his former Mohawk wife.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Defines Jamie's rule and adds Ian's new child to the household.

beats.label: S6 · Fire and Faith
beats.text: Fergus dies in a print-shop fire; a lace square and an old song tie the orphan Fanny to Claire's stillborn daughter Faith, hinting Faith did not die in Paris.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off Fergus and opens the season's biggest mystery about Claire's lost child.

beats.label: S6 · John taken
beats.text: William and Jamie reconcile in the forest as father and son; back in Savannah, Captain Richardson knocks Lord John unconscious while Percy Wainwright watches.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the William arc and hands off the John kidnap as the season's cliffhanger.

cliffhanger.text: Lord John has just been knocked out and taken by Captain Richardson; Jamie is preparing for the battle Frank's book says will kill him; and the hint that Faith survived Paris hangs unresolved.
questions: Where is Lord John and why did Richardson take him?
Is Claire's daughter Faith really alive?
Can Jamie escape his fate at Kings Mountain?

characters.name: Jamie Fraser
characters.line: Laird of Fraser's Ridge, freshly reconciled with William, marching toward the battle Frank's book says will kill him.

characters.name: Claire Fraser
characters.line: Healer on the Ridge, sitting with the unbearable possibility that her Paris child Faith may have lived.

characters.name: William Ransom
characters.line: British officer and Jamie's illegitimate son; now reconciled with his real father.

characters.name: Lord John Grey
characters.line: William's stepfather and Jamie's oldest friend; just kidnapped by Captain Richardson.

characters.name: Amaranthus Cowden Grey
characters.line: William's cousin-in-law; orchestrated Ben's faked death, drawing William closer.

characters.name: Ben Grey
characters.line: John's nephew; faked his death and turned Continental.

characters.name: Fanny Pocock
characters.line: Orphan taken in by the Frasers; her keepsake and song hint she may be Faith's daughter.

characters.name: Buck MacKenzie
characters.line: Roger's 18th-century ancestor; shot Cunningham to save Jamie.

characters.name: Marsali Fraser
characters.line: Fergus's widow after the print-shop fire; deciding how to keep her family alive.

characters.name: Roger & Brianna MacKenzie
characters.line: Roger seeking ordination while fighting with Marion's Patriots; Brianna building rifles and now pregnant again.

beats.label: S7 · Wilmington rescue
beats.text: In Wilmington Jamie and Ian break Claire out of jail after Tom Christie takes the blame for a killing she committed; Roger begins training for the ministry.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves Claire's arrest through Christie's sacrifice and starts Roger's ministerial path.

beats.label: S7 · Amanda and the Ridge
beats.text: Baby Amanda is born with a fatal heart defect; Roger and Brianna must take the children back through the stones, and Fraser's Ridge burns down soon after.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits the family across centuries again and destroys the home base.

beats.label: S7 · Ticonderoga and Rachel
beats.text: Jamie is conscripted into the Continental Army at Fort Ticonderoga, opposing his own cousin Brigadier Simon Fraser; Ian falls for Quaker healer Rachel Hunter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the family in the Revolution and introduces Rachel, Ian's future.

beats.label: S7 · Rob takes Jemmy
beats.text: In 1980 Rob Cameron kidnaps Jemmy through the standing stones to hunt Jamie's hidden gold; Roger and his ancestor Buck follow, but land in 1739.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the 20th-century family in mortal danger and strands Roger in the wrong century.

beats.label: S7 · Saratoga
beats.text: At Saratoga Jamie is ordered to shoot his cousin Simon; another rifleman fires first, and Jamie escorts the body home to Lallybroch as Ian's father lies dying.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Continental fighting arc and brings Jamie back to Scotland at exactly the right moment.

beats.label: S7 · Presumed dead
beats.text: Jamie's ship is reported lost at sea; Lord John marries Claire to save her from hanging — then Jamie returns alive, and William stumbles onto the truth of his birth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central emotional pivot and William's discovery.

beats.label: S7 · Monmouth and Faith
beats.text: Now a Continental General, Jamie fights at Monmouth where Claire is shot; Fanny then sings a song only Claire's stillborn daughter Faith could have taught her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nearly kills Claire and cracks open the mystery of whether Faith lived.

cliffhanger.text: Claire is recovering from a battle wound; Roger has finally reunited with Brianna and the children in 1739; Rachel is pregnant with Ian's child; and Fanny's song has left Claire believing her Paris daughter Faith may be alive.
questions: Is Faith really alive?
How will Roger and Brianna get themselves and the children back to their own time?
What kind of general will Jamie become in a war he now helps lead?

characters.name: Jamie Fraser
characters.line: Continental Brigadier General under Washington, reunited with his family after being presumed drowned.

characters.name: Claire Fraser
characters.line: Healer at the front line; wounded at Monmouth and now weighing evidence that Faith may have survived.

characters.name: Brianna Fraser MacKenzie
characters.line: Mother of Jemmy and Amanda; travelled back to 1739 to reunite with Roger.

characters.name: Roger MacKenzie
characters.line: Trainee minister; stuck in 1739 with Buck after chasing Rob and Jemmy through the stones.

characters.name: Lord John Grey
characters.line: Jamie's oldest friend; briefly married Claire to save her from the gallows, and slept with her while Jamie was thought dead.

characters.name: William Ransom
characters.line: Jamie's illegitimate son; has learned the truth of his birth and left in fury.

characters.name: Young Ian Murray
characters.line: Newly married to Rachel Hunter; expecting a child.

characters.name: Rachel Hunter
characters.line: Quaker healer; Ian's wife and pregnant with his child.

characters.name: Fanny Pocock
characters.line: Frasers' young ward; her song may make her Claire's granddaughter through Faith.

characters.name: Rob Cameron
characters.line: 20th-century antagonist; escaped captivity at Lallybroch and is still hunting Jamie's gold.

characters.name: Buck MacKenzie
characters.line: Roger's 18th-century ancestor; stranded in 1739 with him.

beats.label: S8 · Cunningham arrives
beats.text: Ex-Tory Captain Cunningham arrives on Fraser's Ridge with trader Crombie; Jamie reads Frank Randall's book warning of his own death at the coming Battle of Kings Mountain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season's antagonist and Jamie's fixed-date threat.

beats.label: S8 · Fergus's parentage revealed
beats.text: Percival Beauchamp reveals Fergus is the son of the Comte St Germain, with a Paris estate held in trust for him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the inheritance Marsali will fall back on later in the season.

beats.label: S8 · Cunningham unmasked
beats.text: Cunningham is exposed as a British spy sent by Cornwallis; when he attacks Jamie, Buck MacKenzie shoots him and leaves him paralysed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Neutralises Cunningham but binds Jamie in debt to militia leader Cleveland.

beats.label: S8 · Ben is alive
beats.text: Ben Grey is discovered alive as a Continental turncoat; Amaranthus is revealed as the one who orchestrated his faked death and grows close to William.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the Ben / Amaranthus / William triangle that carries the rest of the season.

beats.label: S8 · Fire and Faith
beats.text: Fergus dies in a print-shop fire; a lace square and an old song tie the orphan Fanny to Claire's stillborn Faith, hinting Faith survived Paris.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off Fergus and cracks open the Faith mystery.

beats.label: S8 · Father and son, then John taken
beats.text: William and Jamie reconcile in the forest as father and son; back in Savannah, Captain Richardson knocks Lord John unconscious and takes him prisoner.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Repairs the William arc while stealing away Lord John.

beats.label: S8 · Richardson unmasked, Jamie lost
beats.text: The family free John and reveal Richardson as a time-traveller trying to keep the Colonies British — John kills him; then Jamie's ship is reported lost at sea.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms other travellers with agendas and hands off the Jamie-presumed-dead cliffhanger.

cliffhanger.text: Jamie is believed drowned on the Euterpe; Claire faces the gallows for espionage and Lord John has just proposed marriage to save her; and Buck is stranded in 1739 in Geillis Duncan's care as Dougal MacKenzie approaches with clues to Roger's own father.
questions: Is Jamie really dead?
Will Claire accept Lord John's proposal to save herself?
Why is Buck in 1739 with Geillis and Dougal, and how does this reach back to Roger?

characters.name: Jamie Fraser
characters.line: Laird of Fraser's Ridge; reported drowned at sea aboard the Euterpe as the season ends.

characters.name: Claire Fraser
characters.line: Ridge healer; facing hanging for espionage in Philadelphia, with Lord John's proposal her only escape.

characters.name: William Ransom
characters.line: Jamie's illegitimate son; reconciled with his father in the forest before Jamie sailed.

characters.name: Lord John Grey
characters.line: William's stepfather; just proposed marriage to save Claire from the gallows.

characters.name: Amaranthus Cowden Grey
characters.line: William's cousin-in-law; secretly orchestrated Ben's faked death and is entangled with William.

characters.name: Ben Grey
characters.line: John's nephew; faked his death and turned Continental.

characters.name: Fanny Pocock
characters.line: Frasers' young ward; keepsake and song hint she may be Claire's granddaughter through Faith.

characters.name: Buck MacKenzie
characters.line: Roger's 18th-century ancestor; stranded in 1739 in Geillis Duncan's care.

characters.name: Marsali Fraser
characters.line: Fergus's widow after the fire; signing for the St Germain estate to keep her family alive.

characters.name: Rachel & Ian Murray
characters.line: Newly married Quaker healer and Jamie's nephew, starting their life together on the war's edge.
